_: CYBER-FROST-3.8-PS: Blackfrost-AI/CYBER-FROST-3.8-BF16 (a fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, architecture qwen4exp) in peasantsmith's GGUF - one file, routed experts Q5_K gate/up and IQ4_NL down, the n-gram table IQ4_NL, its MTP (NextN) block inside. The `maya` engine runs it from the file in place (tools/iq_pack.py indexes it; tools/mtp_from_gguf.py builds the drafter from its NextN block). "revision" is the commit the file was uploaded at and the file has its sha256: the setup checks it against it. Pictures: "vision" below.
name: CYBER-FROST-3.8-PS
about: Q5_K experts (gate/up) and IQ4_NL (down), 180B parameters, 10 of 512 experts a token

vision._: Pictures: the model's vision tower (27 blocks, Qwen3-VL's merger) as llama.cpp's mmproj, from unsloth's GGUF repo of the base model Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. CYBER-FROST's fine-tune left the tower as it was: all 333 model.visual.* tensors in Blackfrost-AI/CYBER-FROST-3.8-BF16's shard 1 are byte for byte the base model's (checked 2026-10-30), so the base model's mmproj is this model's. maya-vision reads it (the vocabulary from the GGUF above, opened vocab-only); it stays on the SSD / in RAM and is on a GPU only while a picture is encoded.
